title: Phased compliance evidence & acceptance playbook for identity, RBAC, and key custody
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This PRD defines a phased acceptance and evidence matrix for SAML/SSO, scoped RBAC, and customer key custody (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments. The goal is to deliver a repeatable signoff playbook so Solutions, Security, and Engineering can validate compliance artifacts and operational readiness for regulated customers. The approach splits acceptance into incremental phases (identity baseline, RBAC enforcement, key custody integration, and end-to-end evidence) to reduce delivery risk and create discrete customer checkpoints.
scoped_problem: Enterprise customers require deterministic acceptance gates for Private deployments covering identity federation, role authorization, immutable audit trails, and demonstrable key custody. Current ad-hoc signoffs cause rework and unclear readiness signals. We need a single playbook with checklists, rationalized acceptance criteria, and required artifacts per phase.
goals: Provide a minimal viable acceptance path for Private customers to enable SAML SSO and basic audit logging (Phase 1)
Enforce role-based access control with role mappings and policy tests that can be validated by customer auditors (Phase 2)
Demonstrate KMS integration and HSM-backed key custody with rotation and escrow test cases (Phase 3)
Produce a signed evidence bundle (logs, test reports, runbooks) that satisfies typical SOC2/ISO auditors for initial engagements (Phase 4)
Keep the playbook executable by Solutions Engineers with clear artifact templates and automation where possible
phases: Phase 1 — Identity Baseline: SAML 2.0 metadata exchange, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, basic SCIM provisioning (optional), audit event ingestion (authn, session start/stop) into immutable store
Phase 2 — RBAC Enforcement: Role schema agreed, role mapping UI flows, policy-evaluation tests, canary restrict-or-elevate scenarios, documented least-privilege examples
Phase 3 — Key Custody & HSM: KMS integration (customer-managed keys), envelope encryption verification, HSM attestation report, key rotation and compromise playbook, key escrow acceptance test
Phase 4 — Evidence & Customer Acceptance: Collection of logs, sign-off checklist completed, pen-test summary, env hardening checklist, and deployment runbook delivered to customer
acceptance_criteria: SAML: Successful metadata exchange and assertion validation in staging with IdP test account; SP and IdP-initiated auth validated against audit events
SCIM: If requested, SCIM no-op provisioning must not error and mapping must preserve external IDs
RBAC: Role bindings in staging enforce deny-by-default; test matrix of 12 canonical actions shows expected allow/deny per role
Audit logs: AuthN/AuthZ events captured with immutable retention for 365 days in customer-controlled bucket or agreed store; tamper-evidence checksum present
KMS: Customer-managed key encryption flows show successful encrypt/decrypt; rotation causes no data loss for active tokens; rotation test run documented
HSM: HSM attestation (certificate/report) from vendor in evidence bundle OR FIPS 140-2/3 equivalent statement where required
Operational: Runbook for key compromise, emergency key rotation, and SSO failover tested in staging with runbook steps executed and time-to-recovery measured
SLA/Telemetry: Console shows per-route latency & cost breakdown for Private env and alerts wired for audit pipeline failures
signoff_checklist: Security review completed with findings logged and mitigations assigned
E2E staging run executed and screenshots/log extracts stored in evidence repo
Automated policy tests pass (RBAC matrix) in CI and are reproducible by Solutions
KMS integration smoke tests and rotation test report uploaded
HSM attestation or vendor statement present in evidence bundle
Audit retention configuration verified and retention policy applied to customer storage
Runbooks (key compromise, SSO rollback, upgrade) reviewed and accepted by SRE
Customer-facing acceptance doc created and acknowledged by customer security contact
Legal/compliance signoff (if requested) filed against the evidence bundle
rollout_plan: Week 0–2: Identity Baseline — implement SAML flows, basic audit ingest, staging validation
Week 3–5: RBAC — implement role schema, UI mapping, policy tests, internal review
Week 6–8: KMS/HSM — integrate customer KMS, run rotation tests, collect attestation
Week 9: Evidence bundle assembly, security review, customer pilot
Week 10: Signoff and handoff to Customer Success for onboarding
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Vendor HSM attestation timelines slip — Mitigation: offer validated KMS-only path and document mitigations; negotiate attestations as a separate contract deliverable
Risk: SCIM mappings vary by IdP and cause provisioning errors — Mitigation: treat SCIM as optional, provide mapping templates, and require IdP test account for pilot
Risk: Audit data storage size/cost — Mitigation: propose tiered retention and compression with sample cost estimates in evidence pack
Risk: RBAC policy gaps lead to over-privileging — Mitigation: include deny-by-default policy and mandatory policy-eval CI checks before signoff
test_plan: Create a canonical test matrix covering auth flows, session lifecycle, RBAC actions, key rotation, and HSM attestation smoke tests
Automate collection of audit excerpts for each test case and store artifacts in evidence repo
Run manual tabletop for key compromise scenario and capture timings and decision points
Coordinate one customer pilot with predefined acceptance window and post-pilot feedback loop
roles_and_responsibilities: Product (Aisha Patel): Own acceptance criteria and customer-facing documentation
Engineering (Liam Chen): Deliver integrations, tests, and staging runbooks
Security: Lead security review and approve mitigations
Solutions Eng: Execute pilot and collect customer evidence
SRE/Operations: Validate runbooks and alerting, own production readiness
